invariants.rationale: Method calls a utility and returns its result, which is typically non-null.
record is used as an argument to the utility method; a null value would likely cause an exception.
Collections in Java never have negative size.
As per Java conventions, this expression is equivalent to 'record != null' and safe if 'record' is non-null.
Return type indicates result should be an instance of FlatLists.ComparableList.
